question: Does the evidence for a world-model GUI safety verifier isolate context-outcome interaction rather than additive context and outcome scores?

previous_turn_classification.reason: Completed independent review, reproducible table and archive of the eight-call WorldEvolver null, changing next action to stopping that candidate.

established_limited_facts: The fixed scaler and linear head applied to concat(unit(observed)-unit(predicted), pooled_action) yield logit u(context)+v(outcome). Outcome ranking under this head cannot reverse across contexts.

At official transition-ID resolution the 966-record graph is a forest. No complete relational cycle is present; unrestricted test-label ID potentials can fit its edge targets. This is an identifiability witness, not held-out performance.
Simple train-only metadata frequency baselines do not reach the predefined 0.90 RSWT/Harm AUC followup criterion. Best RSWT is0.82818; all Harm AUCs are near0.5.
Native integrity uses a dot product and is not subject to the harm-head additivity limitation. Donor-pair ordering and pooled AUC must not be conflated.
unproven: Actual false-negative rate under a deployed threshold, downstream agent harm, attack success, or effective defense.
That the published head relies on these metadata shortcuts or that richer context-only/outcome-only scores explain its measured performance.
Pixel-level deduplicated input graph, independent safety labels for missing cross-pairs, or transition identity equivalence.
A novel general mechanism, cross-model/task transfer, or ICLR-ready claim.

new_model_resource.native_consumer: CLI returns integrity and harm scores; no fixed deployment accept/block threshold or downstream agent consequences established.

parallel_distinct_source_screens.question: Can storage-only re-sharding of unchanged real experience create false RSSM resets and erase delayed safety consequences?
facts: SafeDreamer sample first-bit resets RSSM, but trusted Uniform/Generic constructs windows.
Saver restores streams through successor links; ordinary storage boundaries are not the physical reset interface.
Changing worker/successor/is_first or window length changes provenance/semantics or ordinary truncation, outside the stated operation.

parallel_distinct_source_screens.question: Does physical rollout used to estimate another agents current viewpoint accidentally advance the world in time?
facts: Native WM trains on static CrossingEnv and represents empty/wall/goal.
POI/person is removed from WM local view, so the proposed moving-person time mismatch is absent in the inspected model domain.
No public checkpoint located in the inspected complete tree/releases.

parallel_distinct_source_screens.question: Can task-policy foresight miss failures caused by repeated task/recovery policy switching?
facts: Paper has WM-mediated switching, but official source remains Coming Soon with no verified checkpoint.
Generic switching risk has hybrid-control prior; no WM-specific mechanism identified.
Recovery RL offers an ImageMaze WM but no confirmed fully frozen matching task actor and safety critic; old runtime and training requirements remain.

primary_prior_art.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
primary_prior_art.relation: Target model and original claims; its main integrity result is not refuted by this audit.

primary_prior_art.title: Does my multimodal model learn cross-modal interactions?
primary_prior_art.relation: EMAP already separates additive effects from cross-modal interaction; generic additive-readout criticism is not new.

primary_prior_art.title: Winoground: Probing Vision and Language Models for Visio-Linguistic Compositionality
primary_prior_art.relation: Existing crossed matching evaluation; a two-by-two construction alone is not a novel mechanism.

next_action: Do not tune metadata features or automatically download LGWM for an already-proven algebraic limitation. Preserve this resource and audit. A future verifier pilot must add independently grounded relation-dependent labels, a concrete downstream decision and a contribution beyond known additive-model diagnostics; otherwise choose a materially different scientific question.
